gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies how {@link Entities#escape(String, OutputSettings)} handles a supplementary (astral-plane) character whose code point sits above the Basic Multilingual
ADDED i2: U+1D559 (MATHEMATICAL DOUBLE-STRUCK SMALL H), encoded as a UTF-16 surrogate pair.
ADDED i3: ASCII cannot represent the character, and base mode has no named entity for it, so it falls back to a numeric character reference.
ADDED i4: ASCII still cannot represent the character, but extended mode knows a named entity (𝕙) for this code point, so it is preferred over the numeric form.
ADDED i5: UTF-8 can encode the character directly, so no escaping is needed.
